LAWS AND REGULATIONS RELATING TO INFORMATION SECURITY AND DATA
PROTECTION
The Cybersecurity Law of the PRC (中華人民共和國網絡安全法) (the “Cybersecurity Law”)
promulgated by the SCNPC on November 7, 2016, amended on October 28, 2025, and became effective
on January 1, 2026. The purpose of enacting this Law is to safeguard cybersecurity, protect national
sovereignty in cyberspace, national security and public interests, and defend the legitimate rights and
interests of citizens, legal persons and other organizations.
Internet service providers who do not comply with the provisions of the Cybersecurity Law and
relevant regulations may be subject to administrative liabilities, including warnings, fines, confiscation of
illegal gains, revocation of permits, orders to suspend business for rectification, and closure of websites.
In cases of serious circumstances, criminal liabilities shall also be assumed by such providers.
On June 10, 2021, the the Standing Committee of the National People’s Congress promulgated the
PRC Data Security Law (中華人民共和國數據安全法) (the “Data Security Law”), which took effect on
September 1, 2021. The Data Security Law stipulates the obligations in relation to data security and
privacy protection for entities and individuals carrying out data processing activities.
OnApril 13, 2020, thirteen PRC governmental and regulatory authorities, including the Cyberspace
AdministrationofChina,promulgatedtheMeasuresforCybersecurityReview(網絡安全審查辦法),which
was last amended on December 18, 2021, and came into effect on February 15, 2022. The Measures for
Cybersecurity Review specifies that, the Cybersecurity Review Office may initiate a cybersecurity review
if any network products and services, data processing activities or overseas listing of companies affect or
may affect national security.
On September 24, 2024, the State Council promulgated the Regulations on Network Data Security
Management (網絡數據安全管理條例), which came into effect on January 1, 2025. These Regulations
clarify the general provisions on network data security management, and also further supplements and
refinesthespecificrequirementsonpersonalinformationprotection,importantdatasecuritymanagement,
cross-border security management of network data, and obligations of network platform.
LAWS AND REGULATIONS RELATING TO ANTI-UNFAIR COMPETITION
According to theAnti-Monopoly Law of the PRC (中華人民共和國反壟斷法) (the “Anti-Monopoly
Law”), which was promulgated by the SCNPC on August 30, 2007 and implemented on August 1, 2008,
andlastrevisedonJune24,2022,hascomeintoeffectonAugust1,2022,theAnti-MonopolyLawapplies
to the monopolistic practices in domestic economic activities in Chinese Mainland as well as the
monopolistic practices outside Chinese Mainland which have exclusion or restriction effects on domestic
market competitions. The monopolistic practices under the Anti-Monopoly Law include any monopoly
agreement reached by any operators, abuse of market-dominating position by any operators and any
concentration of operators which has eliminated or limited or may eliminate or limit the market
competition.
The anti-monopoly law enforcement agencies designated by the State Council are responsible for
enforcementoftheAnti-MonopolyLawinaccordancewiththeprovisionsoftheAnti-MonopolyLaw.The
anti-monopoly law enforcement agencies of the State Council may, according to the needs of their work,
authorize the corresponding agencies of the people’s governments of provinces, autonomous regions, and
municipalities to be responsible for enforcement of the Anti-Monopoly Law. Operators who violate the
provisions of theAnti-Monopoly Law will be ordered by the anti-monopoly law enforcement agencies to
stop the illegal act, any illegal gains shall be confiscated and be imposed a fine.
According to the Anti-unfair Competition Law of the PRC (中華人民共和國反不正當競爭法) (the
“Anti-unfair Competition Law”), which was promulgated by the SCNPC on September 2, 1993 and
implemented on December 1, 1993, and last revised on June 27, 2025, to take effect on October 15, 2025,
operators shall comply with the principle of voluntariness, equality, impartiality, integrity and abide by
laws and business ethics in market transactions. Under the Anti-unfair Competition Law, unfair
competition refers to an operator disrupts the market competition order and damages the legitimate rights
– 89 –

=== PAGE 98 ===
REGULATORY OVERVIEW
and interests of other operators or consumers in violation of the provisions of theAnti-unfair Competition
Law in the production and operating activities. Operators who violate of theAnti-unfair Competition Law
shall bear corresponding civil, administrative or criminal responsibilities depending on the specific
circumstances.
LAWS AND REGULATIONS RELATING TO OVERSEAS LISTING
The CSRC promulgated the Trial Administrative Measures of Overseas Securities Offering and
Listing by Domestic Companies (境內企業境外發行證券和上市管理試行辦法) (the “Overseas Listing
Trial Measures”) and five related guidelines on February 17, 2023, which came into effect on March 31,
2023. The Overseas Listing Trial Measures introduce a new filing regime which requires PRC domestic
companies to register their direct and indirect overseas listings and securities offerings with the CSRC by
filing materials on key compliance issues. The Overseas Listing Trial Measures provide that overseas
listing and offering are explicitly prohibited, if any of the following applies: (i) such securities offering
and listing are explicitly prohibited by specific laws and regulations; (ii) the proposed securities offering
andlistingmayendangernationalsecurityasreviewedanddeterminedbycompetentauthoritiesunderthe
State Council; (iii) the domestic company or its controlling shareholder(s) and the actual controller, have
committed crimes including corruption, bribery, embezzlement, misappropriation of property or
undermining the order of the socialist market economy in the past three years; (iv) the domestic company
is currently under investigations for suspicion of criminal offenses or major violations of laws and
regulations which have not definitive conclusion; or (v) there are material ownership disputes over equity
held by the domestic company’s controlling shareholder(s) or by other shareholder(s) that are controlled
by the controlling shareholder(s) and/or actual controller. As advised by our PRC Legal Advisors, we do
not fall within any of the aforementioned situations which would prohibit us from listing overseas.
The CSRC and other three relevant government authorities promulgated the Provisions on
Strengthening the Confidentiality and Archives Administration of Overseas Securities Offering and
Listing by Domestic Companies (關於加強境內企業境外發行證券和上市相關保密和檔案管理工作的規
定) (the “Provision on Confidentiality”) on February 24, 2023, and came into effect on March 31, 2023.
Pursuant to the Provision on Confidentiality, when a domestic company provides or publicly discloses the
documents and materials involving state secrets and working secrets of state organs to the relevant
securities companies, securities service institutions, overseas regulatory authorities and other entities and
individuals,orprovidesorpubliclydisclosessuchthedocumentsandmaterialsthroughitsoverseaslisting
subjects, it shall report to the competent department with the examination and approval authority for
approval, and file with the same level secrecy administration department. Domestic companies providing
accounting archives or copies thereof to entities and individuals such as securities companies, securities
service institutions and overseas regulatory authorities shall perform the relevant procedures according to
relevant regulations. The working papers formed within the territory of the PRC by the securities
companies and securities service institutions that provide related services for the overseas offering and
listing of domestic enterprises shall be kept within the territory of the PRC. Cross-border transferring of
such working papers shall go through the examination and approval formalities in accordance with the
relevant regulations.
LAWS AND REGULATIONS RELATING TO FULL CIRCULATION OF H SHARES
“Full circulation” means listing and circulating on the Stock Exchange of the domestic unlisted
shares of an H-share listed company, including unlisted domestic shares held by domestic shareholders
prior to overseas listing, unlisted domestic shares additionally issued after overseas listing, and unlisted
shares held by foreign shareholders. On November 14, 2019, the CSRC announced the Guidelines for the
“FullCirculation”ProgramforDomesticUnlistedSharesofH-shareListedCompanies(Announcementofthe
CSRC [2019] No. 22) (H股公司境內未上市股份申請「全流通」業務指引(中國證券監督管理委員會公告
[2019]22號)) (the “Guidelines for the ‘Full Circulation’”), which was amended onAugust 10, 2023.
AccordingtotheGuidelinesforthe“FullCirculation”,shareholdersofdomesticunlistedsharesmay
determine by themselves through consultation the amount and proportion of shares, for which an
application will be filed for circulation, provided that the requirements laid down in the relevant laws and
regulations and set out in the policies for state-owned asset administration, foreign investment and
– 90 –

=== PAGE 99 ===
REGULATORY OVERVIEW
industry regulation are met, and the corresponding H-share listed company may be entrusted to file the
said application for “full circulation”. To file an application for “full circulation”, an H-share listed
company shall file the application with the CSRC according to the administrative licensing procedures
necessary for the “examination and approval of public issuance and listing (including additional issuance)
of shares overseas by a joint stock company”.
On December 31, 2019, China Securities Depository and Clearing Corporation Limited (“CSDC”)
and the Shenzhen Stock Exchange jointly announced the Measures for Implementation of H-share “Full
Circulation” Business (H股「全流通」業務實施細則) (the “Measures for Implementation”). The
businesses of cross-border transfer registration, maintenance of deposit and holding details, transaction
entrustment and instruction transmission, settlement, management of settlement participants, services of
nominal holders, etc. in relation to the H-share “full circulation business”, are subject to the Measures for
Implementation.
In order to fully promote the reform of H-shares “full circulation” and clarify the business
arrangement and procedures for the relevant shares’ registration, custody, settlement and delivery,
Shenzhen Branch of China Securities Depository and Clearing Corporation Limited has issued the
Guidelines to the Program for “Full Circulation” of H-shares (H股「全流通」業務指南) in September,
2024, which specified the business preparation, account arrangement, cross-border share transfer
registration and overseas centralized custody, etc. According to the Overseas Listing Trial Measures, the
H-shares “full circulation” should comply with the relevant regulations of the CSRC, and the domestic
company should be entrusted to file with the CSRC.

HISTORY, DEVELOPMENT AND CORPORATE STRUCTURE
OVERVIEW
We primarily manufacture and sell robotic products, and, to a lesser extent, provide related robotic
solutionsinChineseMainlandandoverseasmarkets,dedicatedtothedesign,development,manufacturing
and commercialization of our offerings. Leveraging our proprietary technology platform, we have
cultivated a dynamic robotic application portfolio, comprising industrial robots, flexible collaborative
robots, embodied intelligent robots, and related robotic solutions characterized by performance, agility,
intelligence, safety and robustness.
Our Company was incorporated as a limited liability company under the laws of the PRC in
December 2014. Mr. Tuo, our founder, is a distinguished entrepreneur, innovator and business leader.
Under leadership and management of Mr. Tuo, in terms of revenue in 2025, we ranked No. 6 among
domestic robot providers in China’s industrial robot market with a market share of 0.9%, and No. 6 in
China’s collaborative robot market with a market share of 4.8%, according to the CIC Report.We are also
theonlyproviderofflexiblecollaborativerobotsatanannualproductionexceeding1,000unitsamongthe
top six collaborative robot providers in China. We are also one of the top five providers in China’s
embodied intelligent robotic arm market with a market share of 6.3%, according to the same source. See
“Directors and Senior Management” for the biographical details of Mr. Tuo. Since our establishment, we
have conducted several rounds of pre-IPO investments to fund our strategic growth and broaden our
shareholder base. See “—Pre-IPO Investments” for details. In December 2024, we were converted into a
joint stock company with limited liability. See “—Our Company and Major Shareholding Movement
During the Track Record Period—Joint Stock Reform of Our Company” for details.
Mr. Tuo has been our ultimate Controlling Shareholder since our establishment. As of the Latest
Practicable Date, Mr. Tuo collectively controlled 38.78% of the voting power at the general meetings of
our Company, comprising (i) 13.46% beneficially owned by Mr. Tuo, (ii) 15.44% collectively held by
Luoshi Brothers LP and Ruluo Brothers LP, which are our Employee Share Ownership Platforms and
controlled by Mr. Tuo acting as the sole general partner, (iii) 4.94%, 2.89% and 2.05% held by Tibet

LP, constituted the group of our Controlling Shareholders as of the Latest Practicable Date and will be the
group of our Controlling Shareholders upon the Listing pursuant to the Listing Rules.

of the Pre-IPO investment by the percentage of the new subscribed equity interest in the total registered capital of our
Company at the relevant time. The pre-money valuation is calculated by excluding the total consideration of equity
subscriptions from the post-money valuation under the relevant round of the pre-IPO investment. The valuation of our
Company has been increasing along with our rapid business development.
(2) TheconsiderationforthePre-IPOinvestmentswasdeterminedbasedonarm’slengthnegotiationsbetweentheCompanyand
the Pre-IPO Investors, taking into account the timing of the investments and the status of our business and financial
performance. Under certain transfers of equity interest between our investors, the relevant investors considered various
factors, such as timing of the transaction, past or present relationships between the parties and their respective bargaining
power in the negotiations when determining the consideration, in addition to the then valuation of our Company, and thus
agreed on a discount to the then valuation.
(3) The cost per Share is calculated based on dividing the consideration by the number of Shares subscribed or acquired as
adjusted by the enlarged registered share capital of our Company as a result of the joint stock reform and the Share
Subdivision to be undertaken immediately prior to the Listing.

Use of Proceeds from the Pre-IPO Investments
Theproceedsreceivedbyusfromthepre-IPOinvestmentswhichinvolvedsubscriptionsofincreased
registered capital of our Company amounted to approximately RMB1,463.2 million. As of the Latest
Practicable Date, all of the proceeds from the pre-IPO investments had been utilized for our general
operation and working capital purposes.
Special Rights of Our Pre-IPO Investors
In connection with the pre-IPO investments, our Pre-IPO Investors were granted certain special
rights, including, among others, pre-emptive right, right of first refusal, right of co-sale, redemption right,
information right, anti-dilution right, and special rights in liquidation pursuant to our current effective
shareholders agreement and articles of association. In anticipation of the Global Offering, our
Shareholders entered into the special rights termination agreement dated September 17, 2025, pursuant to
which, among others, (i) their redemption rights are terminated upon the submission of application for the
Listingbyus(the“Submission”),providedintheeventwhere(a)theSubmissioniswithdrawnorrejected,
(b) the Listing is not consummated within 18 months of the Submission or within 12 months after
completion of the CSRC Filing, or (c) any material impediment arises rendering our Company unable to
satisfy the Listing conditions, such redemption rights shall immediately and automatically be reinstated,
and (ii) all other special rights granted to our Pre-IPO Investors shall be terminated before the Listing.
Compliance with the Guide
Based on the fact that (i) the consideration for the pre-IPO investments was irrevocably settled more
than 120 days before the Listing Date, and (ii) the special rights granted to the Pre-IPO Investors shall be
terminated in compliance with Chapter 4.2 of the Guide, the Joint Sponsors have confirmed that the
pre-IPO investments are in compliance with the Chapter 4.2 of the Guide.
Information regarding Our Principal Pre-IPO Investors
Set out below is a description of our principal Pre-IPO Investors (being our sophisticated
institutional investors). To the best knowledge of our Directors, each of our principal Pre-IPO Investors
isindependentfromandnotconnectedwithanyDirector,chiefexecutiveorsubstantialshareholderofour
Company, or its subsidiaries, or any of their respective close associates, and has no historical or current
relationshipwithourGroupotherthanitsrespectivepre-IPOinvestmentandtheVotingProxyAgreements
with Mr. Tuo as disclosed in this prospectus. Furthermore, each of such Pre-IPO Investors is independent
from each other unless as disclosed otherwise.

SCGC Investors (SCGC and Beijing Yitang)

managed venture capital investment institution with a primary focus to invest in innovative high-tech

vehicles in respect of which TR Advisors Limited (“TR Capital”) acts as investment sub-advisor. The
ultimate beneficial owner of TR Capital, and the general partners to such vehicles, is Mr. Paul Robine.
Founded in 2007, TR Capital is a leading pan-Asian secondary private equity firm with six offices across
the region. TR Capital provides liquidity solutions to private equity investors through direct and GP-led
secondary transactions, focusing on high-quality companies and portfolios. TR Capital has invested in
innovative leaders across Technology, Next-Generation Consumer, and Healthcare. With a hands-on
secondary investment approach, the firm partners closely with general partners and portfolio companies
to create value and deliver shorter-duration, risk-adjusted returns for its investors.

PRC Legal Advisor’s Confirmation
As advised by our PRC LegalAdvisor, the equity transfers and increases in the registered capital in

and settled, and all the necessary regulatory approvals, registrations or filings have been granted in

A SHARE LISTING ATTEMPT
In December 2024, we made a preliminary filing (上市輔導備案) with the Shandong Regulatory
Bureau of CSRC (中國證券監督管理委員會山東監管局) in relation to a tutoring agreement with Guotai
Haitong Securities Co., Ltd. (國泰海通證券股份有限公司) in connection with an A shares listing (the
“Proposed A Share Listing”), pursuant to which Guotai Haitong Securities Co., Ltd. agreed to act as the
tutoring institution of our Company to provide guidance and preliminary compliance advice on the
requirements of the CSRC and the Shanghai Stock Exchange. Since the execution of the tutoring
agreement and up to the Latest Practicable Date, (i) our Company did not receive any comments or
inquiries from the CSRC or the Shanghai Stock Exchange in connection with the Proposed A Share
Listing, and (ii) our Company had not submitted any formal listing application for the ProposedAShare
Listing.
To further expand our business and considering that the Stock Exchange would provide us with an
international platform to enhance our capital access, attract diverse overseas investors and broaden our
shareholder base, we voluntarily decided to pursue a listing in Hong Kong. We voluntarily decided to
terminate the ProposedAShare Listing inAugust 2025 and formally submitted the cessation notification
to the CSRC on September 30, 2025.As of the Latest Practicable Date, we had not submitted any formal
application to any recognized stock exchange in the PRC for an A shares listing.
To the best of their knowledge and belief, our Directors are not aware of any other matters relating
to the ProposedAShare Listing that which may materially and adversely affect the Company’s suitability
for Listing and need to be brought to the attention of the Stock Exchange or the Shareholders, which is
concurred by the Joint Sponsors, and there were no disagreements between the Group and then
professional parties.

LOCK-UP PERIOD
Pursuant to the applicable PRC law, within the 12 months following the Listing Date, all existing
Shareholders (including our Pre-IPO Investors and our Employee Share Ownership Platforms) are
prohibited from disposing of any of the Shares held by them.
PUBLIC FLOAT
Pursuant to Rule 19A.13A(1) of the Listing Rules, assuming that the Over-allotment Option is not
exercised,basedontheOfferPriceofHK$38.00perOfferShare,ourexpectedmarketcapitalizationupon
the Listing is approximately HK$9.95 billion, and the minimum prescribed public float percentage
applicable to our Shares is 15.08% under 19A.13A(1) of the Listing Rules.
Our Company has applied for H Share full circulation to convert an aggregate of 226,759,580
Unlisted Shares (after the Share Subdivision) held by our existing Shareholders, representing 95.00% of
the total issued Shares of our Company as of the Latest Practicable Date.
Amongthe226,759,580HShares(aftertheShareSubdivision)tobeconvertedfromUnlistedShares
andlistedontheStockExchange,followingtheCompletionoftheShareSubdivision,theGlobalOffering
and the Conversion of Unlisted Shares into H Shares:
(a) 80,637,900 H Shares (after the Share Subdivision) representing approximately 30.81% of our
total issued Shares upon the Listing (assuming that the Over-allotment Option is not
exercised)) will not be counted towards the public float for the purpose of Rule 19A.13A(1) of
the Listing Rules upon the Listing as such H Shares are controlled by Mr. Tuo;
(b) the remaining 146,121,680 H Shares (representing approximately 55.83% of our total issued
SharesupontheListing(assumingtheOver-allotmentOptionisnotexercised))willbecounted
towards the public float for the purpose of Rule 19A.13A(1) of the Listing Rules after the
Listing as such Shares are held or controlled by Shareholders that are not core connected
persons of our Company upon the Listing nor accustomed to take instructions from our
Company’s core connected persons in relation to the acquisition, disposal, voting or other
disposition of their Shares and their acquisition of Shares were not financed directly or
indirectly by our Company’s core connected persons.
Therefore, our Company will be able to meet the minimum public float requirement under Rule
19A.13A(1) of the Listing Rules.
See “Share Capital—Conversion of Our Unlisted Shares into H Shares” for more details of the H
Shares to be converted from Unlisted Shares and listed on the Stock Exchange following the completion
of the Share Subdivision, the Global Offering and the Conversion of Unlisted Shares into H Shares.
FREE FLOAT
Rule19A.13CoftheListingRulesprovidesthat,whereanewapplicantisaPRCissuerwithnoother
listed shares at the time of Listing, this will normally mean that the portion of H shares for which listing
is sought that are held by the public and not subject to any disposal restrictions (whether under contract,
the Listing Rules, applicable laws or otherwise), at the time of listing, must:(a) represent at least 10% of
the total number of issued shares in the class to which H shares belong at the time of listing (excluding
treasury shares), with an expected market value at the time of listing of not less than HK$50,000,000; or
(b) have an expected market value at the time of listing of not less than HK$600,000,000.
Our Company will be able to satisfy the free float requirements under Rule 19A.13C of the Listing
Rules.

OVERVIEW
We primarily manufacture and sell robotic products, and, to a lesser extent, provide related robotic
solutionsinChineseMainlandandoverseasmarkets,dedicatedtothedesign,development,manufacturing
and commercialization of our offerings. Leveraging our proprietary technology platform, we have
cultivated a dynamic robotic application portfolio, comprising industrial robots, flexible collaborative
robots, embodied intelligent robots, and related robotic solutions characterized by performance, agility,
intelligence, safety and robustness.
We provide a broad portfolio of intelligent robots and robotic solutions. Our industrial robots are
engineered for manufacturing applications requiring significant speed, precision, and operational
reliability. For processes necessitating seamless human-robot collaboration, our collaborative robots
enable flexible manufacturing and intricate operations such as precision assembly and welding. Our
embodied intelligent robots are the industry’s first to achieve large-scale commercial deployment in the
consumerelectronicssector,accordingtotheCICReport,performingtasksincludingassemblyoperations,
materialhandlingandunmannedretail.Beyondtraditionalmanufacturing,ourcollaborativeandembodied
intelligent robots are deployed across diverse high-growth sectors, including commercial services and
healthcare. Leveraging our broad product portfolio, proprietary technology platform, and expansive
service network, we deliver robots and robotic solutions to over 1,000 customers from diverse industry
sectors across over 40 countries and regions.
We are one of the earliest domestic companies in China capable of producing both industrial and
collaborative robots at an annual production exceeding 1,000 units, reflecting an industry trend toward
integrated manufacturing automation, according to the CIC Report. Although our business scale is
relatively modest, this early capability was enabled by our proprietary robot technology platform and
strategicR&Dfocusonconcurrentdevelopmentofbothproductlinesfromtheoutset.Intermsofrevenue
in2025,werankedNo.6amongdomesticrobotprovidersinChina’sindustrialrobotmarketwithamarket
share of 0.9%, and No. 6 in China’s collaborative robot market with a market share of 4.8%, according
to the CIC Report. We are also the only provider of flexible collaborative robots at an annual production
exceeding 1,000 units among the top six collaborative robot providers in China. We are also one of the
top five providers in China’s embodied intelligent robotic arm market with a market share of 6.3%,
according to the same source.
Our Market Opportunity
Driven by the accelerating population aging, rising labor costs, expanding downstream application
scenarios, and growing policy support, China’s industrial robot industry has continued to grow and is
expected to reach RMB37.3 billion in 2030, at a CAGR of 9.3% from 2025 to 2030, according to the CIC
Report. Within this industry, China’s vertical articulated robot market is expected to reach RMB29.9
billionin2030,ataCAGRof8.9%from2025to2030,andChina’scollaborativerobotmarketisexpected
toreachRMB11.1billioninChinain2030,ataCAGRof30.7%from2025to2030,accordingtothesame
source.
China’s manufacturing sector is rapidly embracing intelligent automation. At the same time, global
supply chain shifts and trade changes are driving demand for more flexible production solutions. These
trendsareacceleratinggrowthintheindustrialrobotmarket.Technologicaladvanceshavemadeindustrial
robots more precise, efficient, and reliable. They can now handle complex tasks while improving both
productivity and operational stability. The growing local production of key components has also made
industrial robots more affordable. This has increased their adoption in major industry sectors, such as
automotive, consumer electronics, and new energy. Supportive government policies, including the 14th
Five-Year Plan for Robot Industry Development, are further accelerating industry growth and technology
adoption.
Collaborative robots, distinct from traditional industrial robots, are recognized for their agility,
safety, and ease of use. Rather than simply serving as an auxiliary to industrial robots, they have emerged
as a standalone growth driver in intelligent automation. These robots facilitate seamless human-machine
collaboration on production lines while also addressing application gaps unsuited for traditional industrial
equipment. Advances in core technologies, such as intelligent force sensing and machine vision, have
expanded their applications from basic material handling to precision assembly and further beyond

Advancements in AI are enabling embodied intelligent robots to move beyond simple repetitive
tasks. These robots now have capabilities such as autonomous learning, environmental adaptation, and
precise decision-making. Through breakthroughs in multimodal sensing, real-time tactile feedback,
human-robot interaction, AI models, and machine vision, they operate effectively in complex industrial
environments, performing advanced welding, precision assembly, and quality inspection. Simultaneously,
they are expanding into other sectors, such as logistics sorting, security inspection, commercial cleaning,
cultural performance, and scientific research and education. This technological evolution is driving
significant growth in new application scenarios, substantially expanding the potential scope of robotic
applications worldwide.

We have built a platform that fully integrates technology, products and applications. Based on this
foundation, our robotic offerings meet critical performance benchmarks, such as repeatability, speed, and
force control precision, on par with top international competitors.This enables efficient and rapid product
iteration, supporting the transition towards intelligent automation worldwide.

Our Technology and Embodied AI Model Training Platforms
Our technology platform is built on a suite of proprietary core technologies, primarily including
integrated joint force control, high-speed precision control, and intelligent vision and planning. The
foundationofourplatformisourproprietaryrobotdesigntechnology,poweredbyourself-designedxCore
control system. This system supports multiple robot types and is enhanced by our embodied AI model
training platform, which adds advanced AI capabilities in terms of multimodal perception, adaptive
decision-making and real-time motion control to our robotic offerings. Our xCore control system offers
standardized interfaces for hardware and process package expansion, allowing customers and partners to
deploy customized solutions on their own while benefiting from sharedAI insights that address last-mile
challenges in various application scenarios. We provide full technical support through, among others,
documentation, community forums, and training programs. Our AI Service Agent enables predictive
maintenance to reduce downtime and ensure continuous operation. Based on our technology stack, we
offer a diverse range of robots and process packages for a wide variety of application scenarios.

LeveragingourtechnologyandembodiedAImodeltrainingplatforms,wedeliverrobotsandrobotic

 Performance. Our advanced motion control technologies provide competitive speed and
precision, supported by expertise in both rigid and flexible body dynamics. Our xCore control
system integrates sophisticated algorithms for vibration suppression and high-sensitivity
collision detection, achieving an absolute positioning precision of 0.15 mm. Our proprietary
vibration suppression technology enhances operational stability, reducing joint jitter by over
80%. These technological advantages enable the deployment of our robots and robotic
solutions in high-precision sectors, including semiconductor manufacturing and medical
services.
 Agility. Our robots utilize integrated force sensors and proprietary force-position algorithms to
achieve responsive, tactile motion control.With high-precision torque sensors, advanced servo
drives, and dynamic force control, our systems enable sensitive collision detection, force-
guided assembly, medical applications, and safe human-robot collaboration. Our collaborative
robots showcase competitive performance in ingress protection rating, payload, and reach.
 Intelligence. We prioritize intuitive human-robot interaction and cross-scenario adaptability.
By integrating multimodal perception with our embodied AI model, we equip our robots with
advanced perception, decision-making, and execution capabilities. This enables autonomous,
high-precisionmanipulationandsolveskeyindustrychallengessuchasinconsistentworkpiece
quality and complex programming demands. To this date, we have deployed large-scale
applications in core processes such as programming-free welding and autonomous flexible
polishing, helping customers reduce costs and improve operational efficiency.
 Safety. Our self-developed safety controller operates independently from the main system,
enabling real-time monitoring and highly sensitive collision detection without false triggers.
All safety functions exceed rigorous industry requirements, ensuring full protection for both
personnel and equipment. We are the first Chinese robot manufacturer to achieve 21 TÜV
functionalsafetycertifications,accordingtotheCICReport,demonstratingourcommitmentto
safety and quality.
 Robustness. We have a high-performance, high-reliability design verification system for
industrial robots. This system incorporates redundancy and rigorous validation at every stage,
supportedbyproprietarydatabases,structuralanalysistools,andadaptiveanalytics.Asthefirst
domestic manufacturer to achieve national MTBF certification of 80,000 hours, our robots are
recognized for their reliability. Our robots meet the stringent reliability demands of critical
application scenarios, such as automotive assembly and photovoltaic wafer handling.
Our Products and Applications
Our robots feature a modular design built around standardized core components, enabling rapid
interchangeability of motors, reducers and encoders. Select modules incorporate advanced materials,
optimized through topology algorithms, to reduce weight while enhancing rigidity. This approach lowers
maintenance costs by approximately 20% and reduces total robot weight by approximately 15%. We have
also developed highly integrated, modular force-controlled joints that combine motors, drives, reducers,
encoders, torque sensors, and brakes into a single compact unit. These joints enables swift iteration,
facilitate maintenance, reduce weight and cost, and improve overall performance.

Through our commitment to forward design and development, we have moved beyond a

OUR ROBOTICS OFFERINGS
Our robotics offerings comprise a combination of robots and robotic solutions, which are marketed
under multiple series and are well-suited for tasks in industrial, commercial services and healthcare
scenarios. We offer our robots under three principal categories based on their application scenarios and
interaction capabilities. Designed to meet diverse application scenarios ranging from high-speed,
high-precision manufacturing to safe and flexible human-robot interaction, our robots comprise industrial
robots, flexible collaborative robots, and embodied intelligent robots. We also provide industry-tailored
robotic solutions, enabling intelligent automation across diverse industrial scenarios. Our robots are
standardized products that come with multiple standard options tailored to common application scenarios.

considerations.Theseprojectsrecognizerevenueuponfinalcustomeracceptanceofthecompletesolution.

Our Robots
We provide a comprehensive portfolio of industrial robots, flexible collaborative robots and
embodied intelligent robots to address different automation needs across industrial and emerging
application scenarios. The following graphic illustrates our robot portfolio.
Our industrial robots are mostly used in structured manufacturing environments where the work is
repetitive and standardized. For example, they are typically deployed behind safety barriers on production
lines to carry out tasks such as material handling, welding, grinding and assembly. These robots are
designed to deliver high speed, high precision and consistent performance, operating based on pre-set
programs.
Ourflexiblecollaborativerobotsaremostlyusedinsituationswhererobotsandpeopleneedtowork
together. They are designed with built-in force sensing and safety features, so they can operate next to
human workers without safety barriers. This makes them suitable for tasks such as assembly, inspection,
screw fastening and material handling, especially where flexibility or human involvement is needed.
Compared with industrial robots, they place more emphasis on safety, flexibility and ease of use rather
than maximum speed or payload.
Ourembodiedintelligentrobotsaremostlyusedinmorecomplexandchangingenvironments,where
tasks cannot be fully pre-defined and the robot needs to adjust its actions based on real-time conditions.
They are equipped with sensors (such as vision and force sensing) and onboard AI, which allow them to
understandtheirsurroundings,makedecisionsandrespondaccordingly.Thisenablesthemtohandletasks
such as precision assembly, intelligent material handling and multi-step operations across different
workstations,especiallywheretheenvironmentorinputsmayvary.Comparedwithindustrialandflexible
collaborative robots, they focus more on “sensing, learning and adapting,” representing a shift from fixed,
programmed tasks to more intelligent and flexible operation.
To illustrate how these robots are used in different settings, on a modern engine production line, for
instance, our industrial robots handle heavy-duty, repetitive work such as welding or moving large parts
in enclosed areas, while our flexible collaborative robots work next to operators on tasks like screw
fastening or applying labels, where precision and safe interaction are important. In a broader factory
setting,ourembodiedintelligentrobotsmaymovebetweendifferentworkstationstopickup,transportand
deliver parts, and adjust their actions if the layout or workflow changes.

Industrial Robots
Industrialrobotsrefertoautomaticallycontrolled,reprogrammable,multi-purposeroboticarmsused
for automation applications in industrial environments. Their mechanical structures are similar to human
arms, enabling flexible trajectory planning and complex operational tasks. Different from collaborative
robots, industrial robots are often used in dedicated industrial workplaces, which is restricted by safety
barriers as they are not designed for direct human interactions. They operate through programming and
guidance, equipped with multiple joints and sensing capabilities such as vision, force, and displacement
detection. These features enable the robots to perceive their environment and work objects, make
autonomous judgments and decisions, and perform physical tasks in harsh, repetitive, or hazardous
conditions as a substitute for manual labor. We offer a broad portfolio of industrial robots deployed across
a wide range of application scenarios. Our product line is segmented based on payload capacity into three
categories, i.e., light-payload, medium-payload and heavy-payload, each engineered to meet the specific
performance requirements of distinct industrial applications.
Our industrial robots follow the standard vertically articulated robot design, including primarily
six-axis degrees of freedom. The base utilizes a hollow structure to allow for internal routing of cables,
pneumatics, and other utilities, keeping them protected and minimizing interference with the workspace.
The lower arm utilizes a robust link that provides the primary lifting motion, with maximum stiffness to
minimize deflection under heavy loads and high acceleration. The upper arm connects the lower arm to
the wrist assembly, and is designed for a large working volume and to house the motors and gears for the
subsequent wrist axes. In certain robot models, our wrist assembly utilizes the hollow wrist and dual-axis
modular designs, which allows all user cables to be routed internally through the arm and out the center
of the wrist. Our industrial robot series are also designed with IP67-rated body protection and wrist
sealing, ensuring reliable operation in harsh industrial conditions while minimizing maintenance needs.
Our industrial robots have been certified and meet the ISO 13849-1:2023 and ISO10218-1 safety
standards.
The following diagram sets forth an illustration of our industrial robot series.
Light-payload robots
Light-payload robots are designed for agile, high-speed operations in environments that require
precisionandcompactformfactors.Typicallydefinedbyapayloadcapacitybelow25kg,theserobotsare
suitable for tasks such as inspection, sorting, and small-part handling across manufacturing, laboratory,
retail, and educational scenarios. Our light-payload product lineup includes models optimized for
low-load, high-frequency workflows, enabling efficient deployment in space-constrained and dynamic
production scenarios. According to the CIC Report, the industry standard for overall machine protection
rating is generally IP54, with a typical arm reach of 2,000 mm to 2,100 mm and an average precision of
±0.04 mm. Our products feature an overall IP67 protection rating, a 2258mm arm length, and ±0.03 mm
precision, representing competitive performance.

Flexible Collaborative Robots
Collaborative robots have emerged as a standalone growth driver in intelligent automation,
leveraging their capability in facilitating seamless in human-robot collaboration. Designed with agility,
safety, and ease of use, collaborative robots differ from the traditional industrial robots by featuring
lightweight structures, adaptive motion capabilities, and enhanced safety mechanisms that allow them to
operate alongside human workers without physical barriers. Our collaborative robots, which consist
entirely of flexible collaborative robots rather than traditional collaborative robots, are distinguished by
their exceptional collision sensitivity and precision. In particular, as compared with traditional
collaborativerobots,ourflexiblecollaborativerobotshaveachievedbuilt-inhigh-precisiontorquesensors
ineveryjoint,leveragingourintegratedjointforcecontroltechnology,whichenablesrefinedforcecontrol
and enhanced performance in accuracy, safety, and adaptability. For certain major customers, including
Xiaomi, our collaborative robots integrate joint force control with AI-based recognition, solving
long-standing challenges in precision assembly, such as limitations in stability, efficiency, and cost.
According to the CIC Report, the industry standard for flexible collaborative robots typically includes an
IP65 protection rating for the entire machine, a reach range of 800 mm to 1,700 mm, and an average
precision of ±0.05 mm. Our products feature an IP67 protection rating for the entire machine, a reach
range of 988 mm to 2,246 mm, and a precision of ±0.02 mm to ±0.05 mm, representing competitive
performance. At the same time, our flexible collaborative robots have been certified and meet the EN ISO
13849-1:2015, ISO10218-1 and ISO15066 safety standards.
Our flexible collaborative robots feature a lightweight, rigid articulated arm, with five-axis, six-axis
and seven-axis of motion for human-like dexterity. This is enhanced by a compact, smooth form and
design that enables flexible deployment, while intuitive physical guidance ensures quick setup and safe,
efficient human-robot collaboration. By sharing a common xCore control system, which enables
system-level integration across our robots, our flexible collaborative and industrial robots can operate in
a coordinated manner.

Integrated force-control joint. The integrated force control joint embeds the force sensing directly
into the joint’s harmonic drive or output flange, providing exceptionally high-fidelity, low-latency, and
collision-resistant torque measurement. This integration allows the joint to continuously and precisely
monitor the torque being applied at the point of rotation, enabling a robot to perform delicate tasks that
require “feeling,” such as precision assembly, polishing or grinding, where maintaining a specific contact
force is critical. Further, the joint can detect an unexpected collision with a human or object with extreme
sensitivityandreactinstantaneouslybystoppingorretracting.Byprocessingthisforcedatalocallywithin
the joint’s own controller or the main integrated body controller, our integrated force control joint can
execute complex adaptive force control loops at incredibly high speeds, making the robot not just a rigid
positioner but a responsive and intelligent partner capable of interacting gracefully with its environment.
Our embodied intelligent robots differ from industrial and flexible collaborative robots in their
technological architecture and operational capabilities. While industrial robots specialize in high-speed,
high-precision tasks in structured environments, and flexible collaborative robots focus on safe
human-robot interaction, embodied intelligent robots integrate multi-sensor perception and onboardAI to
achieve autonomous decision-making in dynamic, unstructured settings. This distinction is reflected in
their technical specifications: industrial and flexible collaborative robots are measured by motion-centric
parameters such as accuracy and payload, whereas embodied intelligent robots are characterized by
cognitive capabilities such as sensor fusion, computational power and inference speed. In terms of
application scenarios, industrial robots are predominately used in the manufacturing sector, particularly in
manufacturing facilities requiring large-scale production. In addition to the manufacturing sector,
collaborative robots, leveraging their force perception capabilities, are suitable for the commercial
services and healthcare sectors for performing diverse and personalized service tasks. Embodied
intelligent robots are suitable for a broad range of application scenarios requiring high mobility
efficiencies, including industrial, commercial services, and even more extreme environments demanding
flexible and perceptive operations. Accordingly, the pricing reflects these capability differences, with
industrial and collaborative robots typically ranging from RMB55,000 to RMB190,000, while embodied
intelligent robots typically ranging from RMB40,000 to RMB300,000.

Case Study
Our customer, a leading humanoid robotics company, faced challenges to commercialization due to
alackofforcecontrolcapability,causingahighassemblyfailurerate,combinedwithunstableproduction
yields and low monthly production capacity. We provided a joint force-controlled humanoid arm solution
integrating our high-precision force control technology with a certified mass production system. We also
deployed our ROKAE embodiedAI model training platform that captures multimodal physical interaction
data, filling a substantial gap in force data for embodiedAI model training.This partnership increased our
customer’s precision electronic plug/unplug task success rates, enabled the delivery of more than 1,200
units of force-controlled humanoid arms in the fourth quarter of 2025 to support its major product launch,
andultimatelyunlockedover5,000unitsincommercialorders,demonstratinghowprecisionforcecontrol
transforms embodied intelligent robots from lab concepts into commercially viable, mass-producible
products.

The gross profit and gross profit margin of our embodied intelligent robots improved significantly,
from gross loss and gross loss margin of RMB0.9 million and 33.9% in 2023 to gross profit and gross
profit margin of RMB2.2 million and 30.6% in 2024. Such turn around was primarily due to (1) the
commercialization progress of our CMR composite robots, which were in the early launch stage in 2023
and became more mature in 2024, and (2) the relatively higher materials, labor and production costs
incurred in 2023 in connection with a major order, which was undertaken as part of our strategy to
establish benchmark customers in the embodied intelligent market. Our gross profit for embodied
intelligent robots further increased to RMB5.0 million in 2025, primarily due to the increase in revenue,
while our gross profit margin decreased to 10.7%, primarily due to changes in revenue mix and the
early-stage commercialization of newly launched products. In particular, in 2025, we launched our AR
series and fulfilled a large-scale order for such products, resulting in a higher revenue contribution from
these newly introduced models. As the production processes for such products had yet to fully mature,
higher manufacturing and unit costs were incurred, which adversely affected gross profit margin. As we
continuetodevelopandrefinetheproductionprocessforembodiedintelligentrobots,weexpectourgross
margin to improve in the future.
The ASP of our industrial robots decreased from RMB48.0 thousand per unit in 2023 to RMB41.0
thousand per unit in 2024 and further to RMB35.0 thousand per unit in 2025, while the ASP of our
collaborative robots decreased from RMB47.0 thousand per unit in 2023 to RMB46.0 thousand per unit
in 2024 and further to RMB38.0 thousand per unit in 2025, both primarily attributable to (1) intensified
market competition in the robotics industry during the Track Record Period, according to CIC, which
resulted in a general downward trend in pricing, (2) our continuous investment in research and
development and the realization of economies of scale in our cost structure, which enabled us to steadily
improve and maintain our gross profit margins, thereby allowing us to offer lower prices to enhance our
market penetration and strengthen our position among key customers, and (3) changes in product mix
across different models and specifications, as industrial robots inherently vary in pricing depending on
technical parameters such as payload, reach and application requirements, and we recorded a higher
proportion of sales of relatively lower-priced models during the Track Record Period.
TheASPof our embodied intelligent robots decreased from RMB276.0 thousand per unit in 2023 to
RMB208.0 thousand per unit in 2024, and further to RMB40.0 thousand per unit in 2025. This decrease
was primarily driven by changes in product mix and commercialization stage. In 2023 and 2024, our sales
of embodied intelligent robots primarily comprised the CMR series composite robots, which are fully
assembled composite robots with higher prices. In 2025, we shifted from primarily selling composite
robotstosellingalargerproportionofroboticarms,andwerecordedasubstantialincreaseinsalesvolume
of our robotic arms products, driven in part by a large-scale order of more standardizedAR series, which
had a lower unit price compared to earlier composite robot models.

Our Robotic Solutions
We provide industry-tailored solutions to address unique operational needs of our customers. Our
robotic solutions typically embody one or more robots we offer. Drawing on our experience, we work
closely with customers to develop one-stop solutions that address specific challenges and enhance
operational efficiency. By customizing robotic solutions in new industry sectors on a project-based basis
to set benchmark projects, we standardize our solutions and attract new customers in this new sector to
scale our business. Our benchmark projects providing standardized solutions in specific industry sectors
toleadingcustomershavebuiltabroadandhigh-qualitycustomerbaseinthoseindustrysectors,providing
a solid foundation for sustained growth.
Underaroboticsolutionsproject,wedonotmerelysupplyroboticproducts.Instead,weareengaged
as the primary system integrator responsible for delivering a complete, project-based automation solution
tailored to the customer’s specific production process. Our robotic solution sales model differs from
standalone robot sales by delivering fully customized, turnkey automation systems that may include our
xCore control system and ROKAE+ platform software systems as well as our robotic products and
self-developed servos, controllers, torque sensors and other hardware components, typically for
first-of-its-kind applications or automated production lines. The scope of work in such projects extends
well beyond the provision of robotic hardware. It may encompass, among other things, (1) the design of
customized workstations and production line layouts, (2) the integration of standardized robots with
conveyors, fixtures, vision systems, sensors, safety systems and other auxiliary equipment, (3) the
development and configuration of robot control software and application programs, (4) integration with
customers’ existing production lines, manufacturing execution systems and control systems, and (5)
on-site debugging, trial production and final acceptance based on agreed technical specifications and
performance criteria. Customisation primarily occurs at the system integration and software levels,
includingthedesignofworkstations,selectionofend-effectors,programmingofmotionpaths,integration
with customers’ existing production lines and adjustment of control logic. The level of customization
required also generally varies by project and industry application, but does not typically involve
fundamental changes to the core robot hardware. Instead, value is mainly created through our system
design capabilities, software development and integration expertise as described above.
This approach involves deep engagement from our specialized teams, and the scope of services
covering initial process design and simulation, detailed mechanical and electrical engineering,
procurement,installation,andcommissioning.Theprocessculminateswithafactoryacceptancetestatour
facility, followed by shipment and final on-site commissioning to meet all customer acceptance criteria.
This complete project management approach ensures seamless execution of these highly tailored
automation solutions across diverse application scenarios.

Our Product Development Lifecycle and Business Process
Product Development Lifecycle
All of our robotic products are developed under a forward design and validation system and based
on our proprietary xCore control system, which together form the core of our product development
framework. We adopt a ground-up design philosophy and have established a high-performance,
high-reliability design and validation framework. See “—Our Technology Platform—Our ROKAE
Robotic Technology Platform.” All three of our robotic product lines, comprising industrial robots,
flexible collaborative robots and embodied intelligent robots, generally follow a product lifecycle
comprising (1) technology and platform pre-research, (2) product design and development, (3) testing and
validation, (4) pilot production, (5) batch order delivery, and (6) subsequent iteration or replacement.
Forindustrialrobots,whicharemainlydeployedinstructuredmanufacturingenvironmentsrequiring
high speed, precision and reliability, our product development activities during the Track Record Period
focused on new platform-level models as well as derivative products with different payloads, reach and
application configurations. New industrial robot products typically require approximately 12 months from
initial design to batch order delivery, while derivative products developed on existing platforms generally
require around six months.
Forflexiblecollaborativerobots,whicharedesignedforsafehuman-robotcollaborationandflexible
production scenarios, product development during the Track Record Period emphasized force control
sensitivity, safety functions, ease of deployment and software adaptability. Due to higher requirements for
safety validation and system integration, new platform-level collaborative robot products generally have
a development cycle of around six to 12 months, while expansion products developed on existing
platforms typically require a shorter development cycle.
For embodied intelligent robots, which integrate robot hardware, control systems and application
intelligence for more dynamic and less structured environments, product development during the Track
Record Period focused on system integration, embodied intelligence capabilities and scenario-based
applications. Development timelines vary depending on application complexity, but generally fall within
the six- to 12-month range from design to batch order delivery.

Across all product lines, we adopt a structured pipeline beginning with platform technology
pre-research to product development, then to batch production. By relying on our xCore control system

demand and technological advancement while maintaining product stability and reliability. Following
order signing, the typical manufacturing and delivery lead time for our robotic products is approximately
five to 12 weeks, depending on product specifications and order volume.

OUR TECHNOLOGY PLATFORM
Our self-developed ROKAE robotic technology platform, paired with our ROKAE embodied AI
model training platform, is the foundation and core technological barriers for our business, which enables
us to continue to lead and drive the ongoing innovation of the robotics industry.
– 137 –

=== PAGE 146 ===
BUSINESS
Our ROKAE Robotic Technology Platform
Our self-developed ROKAE robotic technology platform primarily comprise our (1) forward design
and validation system, (2) xCore control system, and (3) ROKAE+ platform.
Forward Design and Validation System. We employ a ground-up design philosophy that ensures
optimal performance, reliability, and innovation from the outset. We establish a high-performance,
high-reliability design and validation system for our robots. This system incorporates multi-layered fault
tolerance, stringent stability redundancy, and a suite of self-developed simulation and analysis tools (e.g.,
strength analysis, lightweight design, overload diagnosis, and motion analysis) to guarantee design
consistency and durability. Based on this system, we have developed over 100 test protocols that exceed
national standards in targeted application, ensuring our robots are built for real-world, high-demand
environments. Based on this design validation technology platform, we can compete with global top-tier
manufacturers in high-end applications demanding high process quality and cycle times, such as
automotive component assembly, photovoltaic wafer insertion, and high-speed, high-precision handling
and assembly in 3C, in terms of accuracy and reliability.
xCore Control System. Since our inception, we have been unwavering in our commitment to
independent forward design and R&D. We launched our first-generation Titanite control system in 2016,
followed by the introduction of the all-new xCore control system in 2021, which has been deployed to
customers for ongoing feedback and iterative optimization.
Our xCore control system integrates the following key aspects of control.
 Motion Control. Our motion control technology achieves an optimal balance of high speed and
high precision, enabling robots to perform complex tasks rapidly and accurately. It is built on
expertise in rigid and flexible body dynamic models, integrated into the xCore controller. This
enables advanced functions including vibration suppression, high-sensitivity collision
detection, installation at any angle, and high-precision payload self-identification. Through
deep algorithm-level integration between the controller and servo drives, we realize true
drive-controlunification.Thesetechnologiesdeliverahighlevelofperformance,evidencedby
an absolute accuracy of 0.15 mm across the entire workspace.
 Force Control. We use force sensors as feedback devices, combining force feedback signals
with input signals like position and velocity, and achieve tactile control of the robot through
our self-developed “force-position hybrid algorithm.” This technology enables the robot to
perceive and adjust its contact force with workpieces, equipment, or the environment more
quickly and intelligently, resulting in more sensitive motion control. Based on self-developed
high-precision joint torque sensors, servo drives, joint encoders, and high-dynamic joint force
control algorithms, the company has developed robot products capable of high-sensitivity
collision detection, force-controlled assembly, force-controlled grinding, massage
physiotherapy, medical surgery, and other functions, truly meeting industry demands for
human-robot interaction and flexible manufacturing.
 Safety Control. Our self-developed new-generation safety controller enables real-time safety
monitoringwithoutrelyingonthemaincontrollerandpossessescollisiondetectioncapabilities
thatare“sensitiveyetimmunetofalsetriggers,”addressingtheindustrychallengeofbalancing
collision detection sensitivity and robustness. All safety indicators meet the stringent
requirements of end-users, effectively ensuring the safety of customer equipment and
personnel.
 Intelligent Control. We transform complex robotic programming into intuitive, task-oriented
operation through advanced AI. Based on multi-modal perception capabilities (vision, force
andtouch)andVLAlargemodels,andleveragingdigitaltwintechnology,embodiedAImodel,
Sim2Real technology, as well as autonomous motion planning and reinforcement learning
algorithms, our robots can autonomously perceive, plan, and execute complex tasks. This
intelligence allows robots to overcome common industry challenges such as poor workpiece
consistency, difficult manual path teaching, frequent process changes, and high-mix low-
volume production. This is proven in applications such as teaching-free welding and
autonomous grinding.
– 138 –

=== PAGE 147 ===
BUSINESS
Our xCore control system enables system-level integration across our robots. This integration
significantly enhances the efficiency of technology iteration, strengthens the scalability of the underlying
architecture, improves key product performance metrics, and streamlines deployment and maintenance
processes.
ROKAE+ Platform. Our xCore control system also offers standardized interfaces for hardware and
process package expansion that enables certified partners to deploy their own solutions on our platform.
Partners may reach intent of collaboration with us to develop robotic solutions on our platform. The
ROKAE+platformisanopenapplicationdevelopmentplatformestablishedonthesoftwarefoundationof
our proprietary xCore control system. Rather than a standalone robot control system, the ROKAE+
platform is a set of standardized and encapsulated software application programming interfaces (APIs)
derived from the underlying xCore control system. Partners may reach intent of collaboration with us to
develop robotic solutions on our platform. Under the ROKAE+ platform, we standardize and encapsulate
certain underlying control capabilities of the xCore control system into software APIs, together with
relevant technical documentation and development tools, and open such APIs to certified partners for
secondary development.
The ROKAE+ platform allows us to facilitate innovation for our partners, as our robotic hardware
and foundational architecture can seamlessly combine with our partners’ specialties in application
engineeringandtechnologies.Weprovidestandardizedinterfacesandacertificationprocess,allowingour
partners to develop and deploy their own specialized hardware and application software, much like an app
store for robots. Platform partners do not modify the xCore control system itself, but develop
application-level software, process packages and solutions based on our robots, robot controllers and the
xCore control system for specific vertical application scenarios. Specifically, we offer open interfaces for
functions such as motion control and force control, along with a lightweight plug-in architecture. We also
provide development tools on our platform, such as software development kits and process packages, that
allow our partners to further develop their robots and robotic solutions according to their specific needs.
The xCore control system focuses on core control functions such as motion control, force control,
safety management and real-time operation of robots, while the ROKAE+ platform focuses on application
expansion and partnership collaboration, extending the application scenarios and commercial value of the
xCore control system rather than replacing it. For example. we collaborated with a partner specialized in
vision equipment manufacturing upstream in the photovoltaic sector by integrating our visual adaptation
interfacewiththepartner’scelllayoutprocesses,facilitatingaroboticsolutionwithcustomizedvisionand
process package. This integration reduced photovoltaic cell layout cycle time to five seconds per cycle,
and has resulted in enhanced efficiency in production lines in the photovoltaic industry.
Toacceleratethisinnovation,weopenlyshareourlibraryofapplicationknowledgeandprocessdata
with our partners free of charge, helping to solve the complex final challenges of implementing
automation. We select and certify platform partners primarily based on their technical capabilities,
industry experience, compatibility with our technical standards and the commercial viability of their
proposed solutions, in order to ensure reliability and consistency of applications developed and deployed
under the ROKAE+ platform. We further support this community with a robust developer platform
complete with technical documentation, forums, and training. To ensure maximum reliability for our
customers, ourAI ServiceAgent continuously monitors robot fleets, analyzing operational data to predict
and prevent potential failures before they happen, thereby minimizing downtime and protecting
productivity.
For application knowledge and data shared on our platform, to which we retain full intellectual
property ownership, we have adopted a set of internal policies to protect our intellectual property rights
and trade secrets against imitation and infringement. Specifically, we have established a specialized
working group to manage and monitor our daily intellectual property-related operations. Our specialized
working group ensures the timely registration and filing of our intellectual properties, as well as the
proactive tracking of the registration and licensing status of our intellectual property rights in order to
promptly take actions upon identifying any potential infringement.

Our ROKAE Embodied AI Model Training Platform
We have developed our embodied AI model training platform, which is a system that spans from
basic automation to artificial general intelligence. We have adopted a dual-track strategy that combines
layered architectures and end-to-end approaches to enable full spectrum sensory perception, including
force, vision and positioning, as well as advanced compliant interaction. By developing and training
specialized operational skill models based on the existing open-source model architectures, we enhance
the existing robotic applications, address challenges in robot deployment, and rapidly expand the
applicationscenariosforourrobots.EnhancedbythisAIfoundation,ourrobotsdeliverreliableexecution,
intelligent decision-making, and heightened adaptability across diverse and complex application
scenarios.
Our ROKAE embodied AI model training platform is validated through large-scale industrial
deploymentsacrosssectorssuchasconsumerelectronics,newenergy,computinginfrastructure,andheavy
machinery. The platform enables micro-Newton-level force control, sub-millimeter 3D vision, and a
multi-modal model training architecture to reduce assembly defects, lower labor costs, and shorten return
on investment periods. Building on this momentum, we expect our platform to serve over 20 leading
industry customers by the end of 2026. We also hold more than 20 core patents and have contributed to
anationalstandardinitiative.AccordingtotheCICReport,ourmarketpositionintheembodiedintelligent
robotic arms industry represents competitive performance. In addition, our open platform architecture
further empowers third-party developers, enabling rapid expansion of available applications. Together,
thesestrengthspositionourplatformasakeydriverofintelligenttransformationinindustrialautomation.

Healthcare Sector
In the healthcare sector, primarily including elderly care and physical rehabilitation, our robots and
robotic solutions are increasingly adopted to support precision tasks and improve service quality. The
persistent progression of population aging is expected to intensify the shortage of medical personnel and
driveurgentdemandforhigh-qualityhealthcareservices.Inthiscontext,robotsareexpectedtobeadopted
increasingly to support precision tasks and reduce repetitive workloads for medical staff. Our robotic
products provide safe, efficient, and highly accurate solutions for the healthcare industry.
 Intelligent rehabilitation services. Leveraging human-arm-like compliant control and force
sensing, our robots enable personalized training in rehabilitation centers, addressing the
challenges of difficulty in maintaining long-term stability in rehabilitation movements and
insufficient treatment consistency due to high physical exertion.
 Jointreplacementsurgery.Utilizingopticaltracking,ourrobotlocatesthesurgicalsiteandaids
the doctor in achieving precise alignment. Based on the robot’s positioning, the doctor can
complete the procedure efficiently. With seven degrees of freedom and an integrated body
controller design, our robot features high dynamic force control technology for rapid response
to commands and smooth operation. Paired with highly sensitive drag-guided technology, it
allows the doctor to operate the robot with ease. Additionally, its core virtual wall and laser
tracking technologies enable more accurate tracking and positioning of the surgical site. This

addresses key challenges, including the inability of the human hand to maintain stability for
extended periods, making it difficult to ensure cutting precision, the high physical demands of
surgery, low efficiency of manual assistance in positioning, and difficulties in coordination.
Furthermore, the robot complies with IEC 60601 and GB 9706 certifications and is finished
with medical-grade matte coating, meeting the stringent requirements of the medical industry.
 Tumor puncture surgery. Equipped with high-dynamic full-state feedback force control,
sensitivecollisiondetection,andvirtualwalltechnology,ourrobotcanmonitorexternalforces
in real time, automatically avoid critical organ areas, and ensure surgical safety. With a
repetitive positioning accuracy of up to ±0.02 mm, it automatically tracks puncture targets,

procedure time. Supported by multi-modal image fusion technology, it enables objective and
precise tumor puncture procedures. As a result, our robot helps minimize additional incisions
and accelerates postoperative recovery.
 Remote ultrasound diagnosis and treatment via teleoperation. Utilizing teleoperation

remote consultations by specialists. This helps address the shortage of expert diagnostic

 Ward inspection. Our robot equipped with a stethoscope/ultrasound probe, can enter patient

examinations, allowing physicians to remotely control the robot with precision. This reduces
workload pressures and addresses the growing demand for diagnostic resources in primary

RESEARCH AND DEVELOPMENT
We have built a platform that fully integrates technology, products and applications. The foundation
of our platform is our proprietary robot design technology, powered by our self-designed xCore control
system and our embodied AI model training platform, which adds advanced AI capabilities in terms of
multimodal perception, adaptive decision-making and real-time motion control to our robotic offerings.
Our R&D Strategies
We execute our R&D efforts primarily through in-house activities, which focus on the development
and enhancement of the core technologies for robotics, which we have established significant expertise
since our inception in 2015. We have targeted our R&D efforts at enhancing our robot body design and
developing embodied intelligence and perceptual interaction, which will serve to advance our robots from
mere execution tools to true intelligent partners.
During the Track Record Period, we recorded research and development expenses of RMB59.4
million, RMB54.2 million and RMB65.5 million, respectively, representing 22.2%, 16.7% and 12.6% of
ourrevenueforthesameperiods,respectively.Ourresearchanddevelopmentexpensesdecreasedby8.7%
fromRMB59.4millionin2023toRMB54.2millionin2024,primarilyduetothedecreaseinourmaterials
and consumables expenses, which decreased by 39.1% from RMB10.4 million in 2023 to RMB6.3 million
in 2024. We scaled back in the procurement of materials and consumables in 2023 and 2024, as a result
of our efforts in refining our material management for R&D prototypes. Specifically, we reduced waste
from stagnant materials used in the R&D phase of our robots and lowered the overall R&D material costs.
Our research and development expenses increased by 20.8% from RMB54.2 million in 2024 to RMB65.5
millionin2025,primarilyduetotheincreaseinemployeebenefitexpenses,mainlydrivenbytheincrease
in the headcount of our R&D personnel. The percentage of employee benefits and expenses continued to
increaseduringtheTrackRecordPeriod,accountingfor69.0%,72.7%and73.7%ofourtotalresearchand
development expenses in 2023, 2024 and 2025, respectively, as we increased our investment in our R&D
staff.
During the Track Record Period and as of the Latest Practicable Date, we had not encountered any
legal claims or proceedings that may have an influence on the R&D for our robotic products and robotic
solutions.
Key Research Projects
Below sets forth some of our key research projects as of the Latest Practicable Date.
NB8 series. NB8 is a high-speed, high-precision desktop six-axis robot designed for 3C, automotive
electronics, PCB, and biopharmaceutical applications. Featuring a new magnesium-aluminum alloy
material, it achieves great body-to-payload weight ratios. Paired with an integrated drive-control cabinet
and the new generation xCore control system, it delivers leading performance metrics in speed and
precision. Our NB8 series is under the planning phase, expected for commercialization in 2026.
NB300 and NB500 series. NB300 and NB500 are heavy-payload industrial robots developed for the
automotive and new energy sectors, with a payload capacity ranging from 300 kg to 500 kg. Both robots
feature a new, independently developed transmission structure and are equipped with an integrated drive
and control cabinet for heavy-payload robots, along with the xCore control system. Together, they are
designed to address the full-process robotics demands of automotive welding, final assembly and new
energy lithium battery manufacturing. Commercialization is expected by the end of 2026.
xCore3.2. Our xCore3.2 control system upgrade is aimed at refining the process packages for
automative, 3C electronics and lithium battery application scenarios, as well as enhancing performance in
speed and precision from the last iteration. The new generation control system began commercialization
in December 2025. In 2026, development will begin on the next major upgrade, xCore 4.1, which will
support automotive applications including spot welding, arc welding, adhesive dispensing, grinding and
laser processing.

Intelligent welding robot technology. The intelligent welding robot is designed for welding
applications in the steel structure, shipbuilding and construction machinery industries. Leveraging
autonomous visual recognition and self-planning capabilities, it achieves fully autonomous intelligent
robotic welding. The system began batch deployment with leading industry customers in March 2026.
Full-torque humanoid arm. Our full-torque humanoid arm R&D project encompasses the humanoid
sensitive torque controlled actuator series of modular joints and the AR series, featuring full-torque
control,highpowerdensity,andlightweightdesign.Thisproductlineseekstoestablishindustrystandards

force-controlled humanoid arms, as well as the full HSA series of force-controlled joint modules for
humanoid arms.
Intelligent wheeled robot. Our intelligent wheeled robot R&D project focuses on the development of
an adaptable wheeled mobile dual-arm robot and control system for the manufacturing and commercial
service application scenarios. The product aims to achieve generalization skills in robotic mobility and
operations via having robots complete autonomous and versatile tasks, in order to replace human labor at
alargerscale.OurintelligentwheeledrobothasbeenlaunchedandbeguncommercializationinJuly2025.
Embodied intelligence system. Our embodied intelligence system R&D project aims to address two
“last-mile” challenges in unmanned factories: warehouse material picking and production line assembly
operations. The project seeks to establish a closed-loop platform that spans across the data collection,
model training and deployment technology chain, by integrating the vision-language action model and
hierarchical model architecture. Our embodied intelligent system is under the planning phase, with the
core technologies validated, and is expected for commercialization in mid 2026.

conceived or reduced to practice, in whole or in part, by the employee during the term of the employment
contract to the fullest extent allowed by applicable laws, and the employee shall promptly disclose all
inventions to us.
